text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower's popularity has<n>skyrocketed since
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But one day, Mihono Bourbon, who<n>up until now
has never had any<n>issues despite her intense
training,<n>sustains an injury.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower spirals, thinking the<n>injury is her fault
because the two of<n>them just became rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But when talking to Bourbon directly<n>about the
issue, she states<n>definitively that the injury has
nothing<n>to do with Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Stunned by her words, Rice Shower is<n>unable to say
anything in reply.
